def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import defaultdict
    # find anchor segments: lines of same nonzero color on edges
    # determine orientation: anchors on left/right edges -> horizontal rays (demo1/2); top/bottom -> vertical
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # collect anchors
    anchors=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,)]
    colors=set(g[r][c] for r,c in anchors)
    # background: most common
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    anchors=[(r,c) for r,c in anchors if g[r][c]!=bg]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in set(anchors)]
    # classify anchors by edge
    left=[(r,c) for r,c in anchors if c==0]; right=[(r,c) for r,c in anchors if c==w-1]
    top=[(r,c) for r,c in anchors if r==0]; bottom=[(r,c) for r,c in anchors if r==h-1]
    # orientation
    if left or right:
        # points fill toward anchor in same row; offset along one segment selects row in opposite segment
        # group segments by side
        def seg(a): 
            s=sorted(a)
            return s
        for (pr,pc) in pts:
            col=g[pr][pc]
            # find which side has anchor in same row
            if any(r==pr for r,c in right):
                # point on right-anchor side: fill from point toward right anchor
                for c in range(pc+1,w-1): out[pr][c]=col
                out[pr][pc]=4
                # offset within right segment
                rs=sorted(r for r,c in right)
                off=rs.index(pr)
                ls=sorted(r for r,c in left)
                if off<len(ls):
                    tr=ls[off]
                    for c in range(w):
                        if (tr,c) not in set(left): out[tr][c]=col
            elif any(r==pr for r,c in left):
                for c in range(1,pc): out[pr][c]=col
                out[pr][pc]=4
                ls=sorted(r for r,c in left)
                off=ls.index(pr)
                rs=sorted(r for r,c in right)
                if off<len(rs):
                    tr=rs[off]

import json
prog='''from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nz=Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x!=bg)
    acol=nz.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    anchors=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if g[r][c]==acol]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if g[r][c]!=acol]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    A=set(anchors)
    left=sorted(r for r,c in anchors if c==0); right=sorted(r for r,c in anchors if c==w-1)
    top=sorted(c for r,c in anchors if r==0); bottom=sorted(c for r,c in anchors if r==h-1)
    for (pr,pc) in pts:
        col=g[pr][pc]
        if pr in right:
            for c in range(pc+1,w-1): out[pr][c]=col
            out[pr][pc]=4
            if left and right.index(pr)<len(left):
                tr=left[right.index(pr)]
                for c in range(w):
                    if (tr,c) not in A: out[tr][c]=col
        elif pr in left:
            for c in range(1,pc): out[pr][c]=col
            out[pr][pc]=4
            if right and left.index(pr)<len(right):
                tr=right[left.index(pr)]
                for c in range(w):
                    if (tr,c) not in A: out[tr][c]=col
        if pc in bottom:
            for r in range(1,h-1):
                if (r,pc) not in A: out[r][pc]=col
            out[pr][pc]=4
            if top and bottom.index(pc)<len(top):
                tc=top[bottom.index(pc)]
                for r in range(h):
                    if (r,tc) not in A: out[r][tc]=col
        elif pc in top:
            for r in range(1,h-1):
                if (r,pc) not in A: out[r][pc]=col
            out[pr][pc]=4
            if bottom and top.index(pc)<len(bottom):
                tc=bottom[top.index(pc)]
                for r in range(h):
                    if (r,tc) not in A: out[r][tc]=col
    return out
'''
